step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a recommendation system divided into two sections: User-Item on the left and Cart-Item on the right. At the top center is an ALB distributing traffic to both User-Item ECS and Cart-Item ECS. At the bottom center, CloudWatch Schedule triggers the left EC2 instance, which trains models/results and writes them to DynamoDB, which is read by User-Item ECS. On the right side, an EC2 instance retrains the cart-to-item model, saves the model artifacts into S3, and triggers a redeployment/update to Cart-Item ECS, which in turn loads the model from S3.
